action.prompt: src/lib/scoring.ts or src/lib/epitaphs.ts was saved. Run `npx vitest run src/lib/scoring src/lib/epitaphs` from the project root. This is a one-shot run (never watch mode) and it includes the fast-check property tests (files named *.property.test.ts). If no test files match, say so and stop. Summarize the result: number of passed and failed tests, and for each failure give the test name, the file, and for a property test the fast-check seed and the shrunk counterexample. Say which source file and rule the failure most likely points to. Do not change any files unless the user asks.
